title: Graphify is cutting Claude Code tokens 71x, saving developer credits #Graphify #ClaudeCode #AIcoding
description:
Graphify launched a free tool that solves the Claude Code token depletion issue, extending a $17 plan's usability from two days to a full month. By building a comprehensive knowledge graph of a codebase with a single command, Graphify eliminates the need to re-read all files each session, reducing token consumption by 71 times.

This technology optimizes coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and Copilot by navigating the pre-built graph instead of parsing entire codebases repeatedly. This innovation addresses a significant cost and efficiency barrier faced by developers using AI-assisted coding.

Graphify's approach enhances productivity and affordability in AI coding tools, supporting broader adoption by lowering operational expenses linked to token usage. It reflects a key step in improving developer experience and scalability in AI-powered programming environments.

#Graphify #ClaudeCode #AIcoding #DeveloperTools #TokenOptimization #CursorAI #GeminiCLI #Copilot #CodingAssistants #AITools #SoftwareDevelopment #CodeEfficiency #AIinnovation #CodeKnowledgeGraph #TechInnovation
